correctness.rationale: The spectrum of each coordinate cycle has smallest positive c_j and maximum L_j. Translation/reversal averaging is convex. The scalar lower-bound max(1-t,Et-1) with feasibility \(t\le1/H\) is attained and uniquely fixes invariant axis weights. Rayleigh saturation by each first Fourier character forces every edge probability in the original unaveraged chain. The delta_n parity trigonometric formula proves the exact holding boundary. A standalone verifier passed 3138 supporting checks; finite numerics were not used as infinite proof.
